findings.title: RS-290 and RS-291 (Facebook session bugs, RS-291 is P1) sit in backlog although both shipped in facebook-tracker 0.10.4-0.10.6
findings.evidence: RS-290 status: backlog, pr/version empty; fixed by f705cef6 (#722), released dcf869a9 facebook-tracker v0.10.4, trackers/facebook/CHANGELOG.md:1290-1300 ('A login finished over Watch is picked up between sweeps'), and docs/debug-notes/2026-10-17-login-finished-over-watch-stays-session-expired.md:59 says 'RS-290, fixed in 0.10.4'. RS-291 status: backlog, priority P1, all 5 acceptance boxes [x]; fixed by 0eed999a (#723, v0.10.5) and 51191d67 (#725, v0.10.6), CHANGELOG 0.10.5 'A saved session survives a restart of any kind'. RS-291's own Context (line 29) already cites RS-290 as fixed in 0.10.4.
findings.failure_scenario: An agent asked to pick up open Facebook work lists backlog tickets (`scripts/ticket.sh list --status backlog`) and finds a P1 'saved login survives any restart'. RS-291's unchecked-looking live acceptance step is 'a logged-in worker restarted with docker restart ... comes back logged in' and RS-290's open box is a live login over Watch; re-verifying a shipped fix that way is exactly the worker restart / login the root AGENTS.md first rule forbids, risking a checkpointed account.
findings.proposed_fix: RS-290: line 5 `status: done`, line 10 `pr: 722`, line 11 `version: facebook-tracker 0.10.4`. RS-291: line 5 `status: done`, `pr: 723, 725`, `version: facebook-tracker 0.10.5, 0.10.6`. Then `scripts/ticket.sh index`.
findings.regression_test: A ticket lint (C3-repro idea): for every ticket not done/wont-do, grep `git log origin/dev --grep=<id>` for a `Release facebook-tracker` or `v1.x` commit and fail if the ticket has none of pr/version but its id appears in a released commit.

findings.title: Done tickets missing pr:/version: (or with a malformed frontmatter line)
findings.evidence: RS-321 line 10 is `pr: "#785"version: 1.294.1` (newline lost), so field() reads no version and INDEX shows '—' though d2d6a86b is v1.294.1. RS-294 pr empty (merged as #768, 1b25ac72). RS-429 pr empty (93f112f3 = #958, v1.370.3). RS-456 pr empty (9372b7af = #996, v1.380.1). RS-404 version empty (#913 is a docs-only prompt candidate). RS-258 version 'n/a — trackers/facebook [Unreleased]' but its fix (7ac27331, #661) is in facebook-tracker/v0.6.0 and trackers/facebook/CHANGELOG.md:1690 under [0.6.0].
findings.failure_scenario: The pr:/version: fields are the join from ticket to CHANGELOG (AGENTS.md 'Tickets' step 4); lookups by version or PR miss these six, and RS-258 claims its fix never shipped.
findings.proposed_fix: RS-321: split line 10 into `pr: "#785"` and `version: 1.294.1`. RS-294: `pr: 768`. RS-429: `pr: 958`. RS-456: `pr: 996`. RS-404: `version: n/a — reddit prompt candidate, docs only, no release`. RS-258: `version: facebook-tracker 0.6.0`. Re-run index.
findings.regression_test: scripts/ticket.sh index could warn when a done ticket has an empty pr or version, like its duplicate-id warning.

findings.title: CHANGELOG.md has an empty stray `## [Unreleased]` heading in the middle of the file
findings.evidence: The only `## [Unreleased]` heading sits between [1.344.0] (line 1569) and [1.343.0] (line 1591), with no body. scripts/changelog.sh:152-189 treats an Unreleased section specially and :264 tells authors to write 'under ## [Unreleased]'.
findings.failure_scenario: An author following changelog.sh's hint adds notes under the heading they find, 1,500 lines down among 2026-10-24 releases, and the notes never appear at the top; backfill may also fold it oddly.

findings.title: facebook-tracker tag v0.13.3 has no CHANGELOG section (renamed to 0.13.4)
findings.evidence: At the v0.13.3 tag CHANGELOG had `## [0.13.3] - 2026-10-19` (pre-screen default model, RS-317). Five minutes later 53be6069 'Release facebook-tracker v0.13.4' renamed that section to [0.13.4] and corrected RS-317->RS-319, so the current file has [0.13.4] then [0.13.2]. Every other facebook-tracker/v* tag has a section; 0.1.0 and 0.4.0 have sections but no tags (pre-import history, see AGENTS.md 'Imported hashes').
findings.failure_scenario: Someone checking what the fleet ran on 0.13.3 (e.g. from `docker inspect` labels or the login ledger) finds no entry and may assume the tag is bogus.
findings.proposed_fix: Insert before line 922: `## [0.13.3] - 2026-10-19\n\nSame tree as 0.13.4; re-cut because this section cited the wrong ticket (RS-317 for RS-319).`

findings.title: Two debug notes still say the transfer-orders test flake is unfixed; the fixture was fixed in v1.191.0

findings.title: Debug note says the new-worker logged-out search is fixed, then says the monitor 'still has the gap'
findings.evidence: Line 3: 'Fixed in facebook-tracker 0.10.1 (RS-286): a missing file now has a fingerprint of its own'; lines 50-52: 'The monitor itself still has the gap. The real fix ... is a vendored-monitor change'. RS-286 is done at facebook-tracker 0.10.1.
findings.failure_scenario: A reader stops at the end and seeds empty fb_state.json files by hand on new workers (a write into configs/sessions/, which the ground rules treat as login-sensitive).
findings.proposed_fix: Replace lines 50-52 with: `0.10.1 (RS-286) made that vendored-monitor change: a missing file parks the worker, so the empty-file step is history.`

findings.title: docs/superpowers/plans/finished/ convention abandoned: ~33 shipped or dropped plans from May-July stay at top level with no status
findings.evidence: finished/ holds 5 plans moved in May (eefd5691); nothing since. Top-level plans with every box unticked include shipped work (2026-05-16-transfer-orders.md: transfer orders exist, 1de98259; 2026-05-22-sell-order-archive.md; 2026-06-08-sell-order-packing-list.md: RS-029 v1.130.0; 2026-05-17-per-order-commission-rate.md) beside likely-dropped ones (2026-05-21-system-metrics-sidecar.md: no sidecar in compose/deploy). Only 2026-05-16-orphan-label-scan-sweep.md has a status line ('DEFERRED'). AGENTS.md:223 calls the folder 'in-flight and finished'.
findings.failure_scenario: A reader cannot tell in-flight from finished plans; an agent executing 'the plan' for a feature re-runs tasks for something already shipped (unticked boxes read as to-do).
findings.proposed_fix: Either move shipped plans into finished/ and add `> **Status:** abandoned (<date>)` to dropped ones, or drop the finished/ folder and require a first-line status in each plan; update AGENTS.md:223 to name the convention.
